readme_excerpt: You-Get NOTICE (30 May 2022): Support for Python 3.5, 3.6 and 3.7 will eventually be dropped. (see details here)) NOTICE (8 Mar 2019): Read this if you are looking for the conventional "Issues" tab. You-Get is a tiny command-line utility to download media contents (videos, audios, images) from the Web, in case there is no other handy way to do it.
